dataset.title: ATF Office Locations
dataset.description: ATF has locations across the United States and several other countries including Canada, The Bahamas, Jamaica, Trinidad and Tobago, Mexico, Colombia, El Salvador and the Netherlands. Each location has staff dedicated to stopping violent crime, enforcing federal firearms and explosives licensing and regulations, and assisting in criminal investigations.

dataset.title: Federal Firearm Licensees locations
dataset.description:
This data was pull from the Tools and Services for Licensees section of the ATF.gov website that contains information for the firearms industry and its members, classifications of firearms and the interpretation of the regulations codified under 27 CFR, Parts 447, 478 and 479.

If you need assistance regarding firearms enforcement-related issues, please contact your local ATF office.
